audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Riven / Riven / Skill x5. The 1694-game packet reads Skill / Riven / Riven / Riven / Mordekaiser / Riven / Riven on a 47.78% win rate.
audit.why: The page's own whys already match the packet: whys[0] calls level 1 'an even farm lane', whys[1] through whys[3] describe Riven winning, whys[4] is the Realm window, whys[5] and whys[6] hand the item phases back to her.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group -> Skill, (1 unchanged), Riven, Riven, Mordekaiser, Riven, Riven, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items were all written as Mordekaiser rows with generic 'the lane flips' text.
audit.why: Her spikes are levels 2-3 (three Broken Wings dashes plus an 11s Ki Burst) and her first item; Blade of the Exile drops to 60s at rank 3, so her ultimate cycles far faster than your 140/120/100s Realm. Your only clean window is level 6.
audit.corrected: Those four whys rewritten to describe her spikes; level 6 stays yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere on her kit, and Valor was described only as part of a combo.
audit.why: Ki Burst (W): 260 range, 11/10/9/8/7s — her ONLY hard CC. Valor (E): 250 range, 10/9/8/7/6s, a dash that blocks incoming damage — the tool that refuses the extended fight your Indestructible heal needs. Broken Wings (Q): 13s for the full three-cast sequence, third cast knocks back.
audit.corrected: Numbers added: commit inside Ki Burst's 11s downtime, and expect Valor every 10s.

edits.before: Q start, but it's slow and telegraphed — Riven dodges it on reaction at full HP. Last-hit, aim isolated Qs only when she commits to a CS.
edits.after: Neither of you has an all-in at 1, and Broken Wings gives her three dashes to sidestep the delayed cone — last-hit and hold Q for a step-up.

edits.before: Full kit plus Darkness Rise — three hits sets your aura burning and the lane flips. E-drag Riven off her wave and run the Q-auto-E pattern on every Ki Burst (Stun) cooldown.
edits.after: Her full combo — three Broken Wings dashes into an 11s Ki Burst stun into a Valor shield-dash — bursts you inside one window and leaves before Darkness Rise ever ignites.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Riven must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Broken Wings ranks make her all-in lethal, and her dashes refuse the long fight your Indestructible heal needs to pay off.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: Her first-item burst ends the trade before your W recast can heal it back — this is her strongest snowball window.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Riven's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: She dashes out of Darkness Rise and sidesteps the delayed Obliterate while her item burst chips you — you plateau into a tanky body, she stays a live duel threat.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst (Stun): matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Riven Ki Burst: Short-range AoE stun — her engage CC. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Riven Ki Burst (W): matchup-defining — a 260-range stun on 11s at rank 1, her only hard CC. - Riven Valor (E): a 10s shield-dash — the escape that refuses your extended trade.

edits.before: Her engage CC. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1 — step in only once it is spent.

edits.before: That is Riven's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: Realm of Death is 140s — spend it when Ki Burst is down, not into her combo.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Ki Burst is her only hard CC — bait it, then Death's Grasp her back in.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Her burst is front-loaded and Valor blocks damage every 10s — bank Indestructible through it and recast the heal instead of racing her.

notes: Content layer here is factually clean — ability names and mechanics all match Riot's text — so the work was the chart and the numbers. The chart contradicted a 1694-game packet in six of seven rows while the page's own whys already described the matchup exactly as the packet does, so those rows are proposed as one atomic paired group. Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60s versus your Realm of Death at 140/120/100s, so at rank 3 her ultimate cycles more than twice as often as yours — worth remembering when 'R on cooldown' is the stated win condition. Not asserted (kits do not cover it): whether Valor's damage block absorbs Darkness Rise's aura ticks, and whether Ki Burst's stun can interrupt Realm of Death's cast.
